correctness.rationale: The exact telescoping identity μ^(-n)z_n=z_0+sum_{j<n} μ^(-j-1)c_j has a tail uniformly bounded by μ^(-n)(|α|+B)/(μ-1) for n≥2 because x_n=sin z_(n-2), y_n=sin z_(n-1) there. This proves global continuity, the stated unscaled remainder and H∘F=μH. Compare same-(x,y) orbits with e_0=z'_0-z_0>0: e_1≥(μ-|δ|)e_0, e_2≥(μ-|δ|)e_1-|γ|e_0≥(μ-B)e_1, and for n≥2 the three sine differences are bounded by e_n,e_(n-1),e_(n-2), respectively. Induction gives growth by μ-B>1. The ordered phases cannot coincide: equal H would make their difference bounded by twice the uniform remainder. On each fiber H-z is bounded, locally uniformly over the base, giving surjectivity and joint continuity of the inverse by sequential compactness and uniqueness. H=0 is exactly boundedness; the one-sided backward recurrence on bounded sequences is a contraction of factor (1+B)/μ, and its smooth sine substitution has uniform Fréchet derivatives on bounded sequences, so I-DT is invertible and the implicit function theorem applies; the stated graph Lipschitz bound follows by comparing fixed sequences. The fixed-point equation is strictly increasing in s and tends to opposite infinities. On the graph one can also check exponential convergence directly without invertibility or a stable-manifold theorem: for E_n=sup_{j≥n}|z_j-s| the bounded future series gives E_n≤[B/(μ-1)]E_(n-2) for n≥2, hence geometrical decay (and exact agreement of z after step 2 for B=0). The Jacobian polynomial in the record is correct; on the homotopy a unit root would imply μ≤1+tB by taking absolute values after division by ξ². Fully invariant compact sets admit bounded bilateral trajectories through every point, and the bilateral contraction is unique, hence there is only the equilibrium singleton. Poincaré recurrence for the possibly noninvertible map rules out invariant probabilities on points tending to infinity or tending to a different point. The witness α=β=γ=0, δ=B gives (μ-1)s=B sin s with opposite signs of the difference near 0 and at π, hence at least three equilibria for each 1<μ<1+B. The invariant zero graph is forward-invariant, not in general mapped onto itself, in agreement with Step 3. At equality the witness has unit multiplier, not three distinct equilibria. check.py was read, not executed.
residual_risks: Only the strict large positive feedback region and the exact below-threshold counterexamples are covered; no blanket claim at equality, at negative feedback, or about differentiability of the full escape coordinate.
The graph invariance is forward invariance. For instance when α=β=γ=δ=0 its entire plane z=0 is not its own image.

evidence: Chen–Li's abstract explicitly covers a Lipschitz invariant set of bounded forward solutions, unique bounded complete solution and exponential attraction for sufficiently small Lipschitz constant; it also addresses smoothness. These qualitative contributions and the contraction method are prior.

Castañeda–Jara §2, assumption (d0) and Theorem 2.7, require an invertible linear part; (d5) ensures unique backward continuation. The linear map obtained by removing bounded sine terms here is singular, and F is not backward-unique. The similarity of the Green-series method, see (2.3), is genuine but does not make that theorem applicable.

Gu–Xia's abstract concerns partially hyperbolic endomorphisms derived from Anosov on the two-torus, not a real sine-delay endomorphism. Battelli–Franca–Palmer's abstract studies noninvertible linear dichotomies, not an all-state nonlinear coordinate.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General Lyapunov–Perron and Palmer machinery explains some of the methods and bounded-orbit behavior. An identity plus uniform tail does not by itself ensure ordered injectivity fiberwise; that requires this delay comparison, and the explicit coefficient-uniform worst-case bound needs its own witness.

evidence: A stable-manifold description can establish the bounded graph, but such a description does not supply a continuous phase on its full complement, prove strict vertical order for two escaping solutions, or identify their amplitude via an error bound independent of starting state after two iterates.

For example F is not injective when β=0, and even with β≠0 distinct z giving the same sine can have the same image by changing x. Thus invertible-system topological equivalence is not a dominating statement. The target is conjugate to a nonlinear skew map whose scalar coordinate is linear, not to a fully linear invertible model.
The sharpness claim concerns all coefficients with fixed B, not the fixed moderate parameter choices in the originating study or the differentiability of the coordinate at equality.

value.rationale: For a published map known from bifurcation plots, a coefficient-uniform threshold that classifies every real orbit and all compact recurrence addresses a natural asymptotic question. The homeomorphic scalar coordinate offers more than a local stability test: it locates the exceptional graph and fixes the sign and amplitude of all other trajectories' escape with a uniform additive error. The scalar witness shows that a uniformly lower threshold cannot give that collapse. This mathematical value is independent of any application of the maps.
residual_risks: The theorem does not equate this sufficient coefficient-uniform bound with the true threshold for each separate coefficient tuple.
